Class ChestUpgradeInventory

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.colossalchests2.upgrade.ChestUpgradeInventory
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack>, net.minecraft.world.Clearable, net.minecraft.world.Container, net.minecraft.world.entity.SlotProvider, net.neoforged.neoforge.common.extensions.ContainerExtension
public class ChestUpgradeInventory extends Object implements net.minecraft.world.Container
The upgrade slots of a core. Each slot holds one upgrade item. What may be inserted or removed is decided by the ChestUpgradeInventory.Owner.
